test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On: 09 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following is NOT a condition for the President's office in India?

options.text: He shall not be entitled, without payment of rent, to use his official residence.
He shall not be a member of either House of the Parliament.
The allowances shall not be diminished during his term of office.
He shall not hold any office of profit.

solution:
The correct answer is __**He shall not be entitled, without payment of rent, to use his official residence.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The President of India is entitled to use his official residence, Rashtrapati Bhavan, without any payment of rent.
 
• According to Article 59 of the Indian Constitution, the President shall not be a member of either House of Parliament or a House of the Legislature of any State.
 
• During the term of office, the President's emoluments and allowances cannot be diminished as per Article 59(3).
 
• The President shall not hold any office of profit during his term as mentioned in Article 59(4).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 59 of the Indian Constitution**

 
 
• It outlines the conditions of the President's office in India.
 
• The President shall not be a member of either House of Parliament or a House of the Legislature of any State.
 
• The President shall not hold any other office of profit.
 
• The President's emoluments and allowances cannot be diminished during his term of office.
 
 
 
• **Rashtrapati Bhavan**
 
 
• It is the official residence of the President of India.
 
• Located in New Delhi, it was formerly known as the Viceroy's House.
 
• Rashtrapati Bhavan includes the main building, large gardens, staff quarters, stables, and other offices.
 
 
 
• **Office of Profit**
 
 
• An office of profit is a position that brings financial gain, advantage, or benefit.
 
• The President is not allowed to hold any office of profit to ensure independence and impartiality.
